name: preview-card-1v
title: Preview Card 1v: Dog-ear
author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
description: A catalogue card for showing a live component preview. The top-right corner is folded over, marking the card as a page you can open.
docs: Every preview card design exports the same `PreviewCard` component, so you can switch designs by changing the import path. Pass the live preview as children.
